snippet.title: Black Sailors: Bay of All Saints - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description:
Learn about the story, meet the characters, and get a peek at gameplay from Black Sailors: Bay of All Saints in this latest trailer for the upcoming turn-based naval strategy RPG. Black Sailors: Bay of All Saints is a turn-based naval strategy RPG set in colonial Brazil, where a crew of formerly enslaved people becomes a pirate crew fighting for freedom in the waters of the Baía de Todos os Santos. Combining tactical naval combat, crew management, character progression, and narrative choices, the game reimagines Brazilian history through a story of resistance, identity, and freedom.

Black Sailors: Bay of All Saints will be available on PC, Mac, and Xbox Series X/S in 2027.
